backup.production_rule: s110 (D-358): role laundry and capability report_supply, utility rates, staff receipt drafts and the KPI tab read model. Two new tables (RLS on, no grants), nine new RPCs/internals, staff_access_allowed redefined, and two live functions patched in place (manage_staff_access role list, record_inventory_usage gate). Nothing existing is dropped. Run only on a restore point younger than one hour, after the s108 release is applied. The orchestrator must fill restore_point and verified_at (the values here are placeholders).
backup.notes: Phase backfill, as s107/s108: the function bodies contain deletes (undo of a staff receipt, 30-day trim of unconfirmed drafts), which the expand check refuses. Applying the migration changes no row. The staff_access_profiles role check is replaced by a wider one in the same transaction.

forward_verification.query: select to_regclass('public.utility_rates') is not null and to_regclass('public.inventory_receipt_drafts') is not null

forward_verification.name: tables_rls_on
